about.title: About
about.description: ThinkingKity uses a folder as a vault for Markdown notes, structured data, code snippets, PDFs, and AI-assisted work. Data stays local first, with optional Git sync when you need it.
about.featureNotes: Markdown notes, wiki links, backlinks, and outline
about.featureFormats: JSONC, CSV, Mermaid, PDF, images, and common code formats
about.featureAi: Configurable AI assistant with contextual files
about.featureSync: Optional Git sync for versioned vault content
about.featureLocal: Local files first, with sensitive AI settings stored separately

updateNotes.github: This reads the update manifest from the latest GitHub release and selects the package for this platform.
updateNotes.android: This reads the update manifest from the latest GitHub release and selects the Android package. A store channel can replace it later.

updateStatus.error: Could not check for updates. Try again later or open releases directly.
